record.challengeId: stable challenge UUID / instance id used as replay seed anchor
record.replaySeedAnchor: UUID seed anchor for deterministic regeneration
record.generationConfig: config snapshot used with UUID seed anchor
record.replaySeedContract: challengeId, replaySeedAnchor, generationVersion, generationConfig, and derivedSeeds
record.exactReplay: availability, method, and reason for snapshot or deterministic regeneration replay
record.attempts: attempt list with score, label, plan, result, summary, pathSummary, timestamps
record.pathSummary: per-attempt waypoint count, sample count, stars captured, energy, hazards, elapsed time, and actual path availability

notes: Leaderboard exports are local-browser save artifacts for sharing saved challenges and attempts. They are importable and merge into localStorage.
